content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - GPU capacity exhaustion in prod-us-west-2. inference-q-gpu queue length growing rapidly (5x baseline). Autoscaler failing to add nodes (Attach/PassRole errors). Paging oncall: maria

maria: acked and on it. checking metrics + autoscaler logs now. queue is at ~18k pending reqs, 90% of GPU pods throttled.

ajay: seeing repeated errors from cluster-autoscaler in control-plane logs: FailedCreate, launch template handshake failing. grabbing recent events.

cheng: can you paste the events? my hunch is an IAM/passrole regression from the launchtemplate rollout last night.

ajay: pasted: ```
$ kubectl -n kube-system get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 10
Warning  FailedCreate  2m (x5 over 6m)  cluster-autoscaler  Failed to create instances for ASG 'asg-prod-gpu-2': LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch: LaunchTemplate version 2026-03-10 not found
Warning  FailedAttachRole  2m (x4 over 6m)  cluster-autoscaler  AttachRole failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/CA-ServiceRole is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole
```

maria: confirmed. Autoscaler tries to spin new nodegroup but AWS rejects PassRole. this lines up with the launchtemplate we promoted last night that references an instance profile the ops team rotated.

cheng: checking ASG/launchtemplate config: looks like LT references instance-profile `ri-gpu-instance-profile-v2`. That profile's role was renamed in the infra rollout (missing passrole on the CA role).

julia: customer-impact update: CS has flagged 3 paying customers (acct A-312, B-91, C-501) seeing timeouts and degraded throughput. communicating ETA.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) manually scale an emergency fallback GPU ASG that still has a working launchtemplate (ASG `asg-prod-gpu-fallback`) 2) patch autoscaler role to allow iam:PassRole temporarily (ops approval required) 3) enable CPU-fallback routing for non-SLA requests to reduce queue pressure. doing steps in parallel.

ajay: manual scale command queued: ```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name asg-prod-gpu-fallback --desired-capacity 6 --region us-west-2
```

ops-bot: started ASG scale action (asg-prod-gpu-fallback) -> desired=6. expected instance warmup ~6m.

maria: patching inference-router to move background/low-priority requests to cpu-fallback pool to preserve GPU tokens for customer requests.

cheng: while ASG spins, I'm preparing a minimal IAM rollback: grant `iam:PassRole` to the CA service role for the instance-profile used by the launchtemplate. This is quicker than reverting the whole launchtemplate. ajay please get ops-approval in #eng-ops.

ajay: pinged @ops on the approval thread. ops leads asked for quick justification and will approve in ~5 minutes.

sam-cs: FYI CS messages sent to affected customers: short note saying we're actively mitigating and expecting partial recovery within 15-20m. escalation opened for A-312 (priority), B-91 monitoring.

maria: ASG instances are starting. monitoring pod scheduling.

ajay: new events showing nodes registering but kubelet is tainting nodes with `gpu-init=failed:NoDriver` on 2 instances — seems the image bootstrap doesn't have the new nvidia drivers pinned. Will cordon those until image fix or use older AMI.

cheng: switching to fallback AMI on the new ASG (rolling replace) to ensure GPU drivers present. initiating ASG update to use `ami-20250310-gpu`.

ops-bot: ASG update initiated, rolling update in progress — replacing 6 instances. expected finish ~12m.

maria: queue length down to 9k after CPU-fallback and the first 2 GPU nodes came up healthy. but still high. throttling decreased from 90% -> 60%.

julia: CS: customers reporting intermittent 5xxs, but some are back to normal. keeping them updated.

ajay: autoscaler logs look healthier after iam:PassRole grant; CA is now able to create instance requests, but still failing to attach if launchtemplate version mismatches. we need to ensure LT versions match what CA expects (we have CA pinned to LT v2026-03-10).

cheng: created a small script to force CA to use latest LT by updating the node group config: ```
bash -x ./update-nodegroup-lt.sh --asg asg-prod-gpu --lt-version 2026-03-15
# script updates ASG launch template and signals autoscaler to retry
```

maria: handoff: I'm going to step out for 40m. @cheng you take lead for nodegroup/launchtemplate ops and liaise with ops for the IAM role hardening. I'll keep monitoring CS threads.

cheng: taking over. action items: (1) finish AMI swap for fallback ASG (2) reconcile LT versions across all GPU nodegroups (3) create a temporary allowlist for iam:PassRole for CA service role and log the change for later rollback. will post updates here.

ajay: add metric alerts to detect LT drift automatically. filed infra ticket INFRA-2543.

maria: final customer-impact note before stepping out: A-312 saw ~2.5 minutes of 503s (peak) and overall degraded tail latency ~3x for 18 minutes. credits recommended for this window. Julia/Sam please coordinate credits and follow-up.

sam-cs: acknowledged. will prepare follow-up comms and a template email for affected customers.

ops-bot: incident-bot: SEV2 acknowledged, current status: partial mitigation in place, queue decreasing, manual ASG + IAM temporary grant applied, follow-up tasks assigned to cheng.

julia: creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem to eng-sre + infra for root cause analysis. ticket: INC-43050 (gpu-autoscale-iam-lt-drift).

cheng: quick next-steps logged in INC-43050. will consolidate LT versions and add tests to CI that validate CA can assume necessary passroles before LT promotion.

maria: offcall, leaving monitoring to cheng. good work team :thumbsup:

cheng: monitoring. will update when fully reconciled and queue <1k.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue down to 820, GPU pod throttling reduced to 12%, CA is healthy and creating nodes successfully. transitioning to recovery mode. postmortem and remediation assigned. thread archived in 1h.
